tasks.prompt:
Extend PQueue.onEmpty and PQueue.onIdle with an optional `{signal?: AbortSignal}` argument. Preserve their existing no-argument behavior and all other public queue behavior.

An already-aborted signal must reject with exactly signal.reason, even when the queue is already empty or idle. Aborting a pending wait must reject only that wait, not remove or cancel queued/running jobs. Remove the wait's queue event listener and signal listener when the wait resolves or rejects, preserving other listeners. Multiple independent waiters must work. Preserve onSizeLessThan filtering. Update the TypeScript surface and a short README explanation.

Only edit source/index.ts, source/options.ts, readme.md. Preserve tests, dependencies and configuration. You may read the acceptance/ files. Do not commit or push. Explain the changes and validation results.

Retire the internal source/lower-bound.ts module completely. Move the binary insertion responsibility into PriorityQueue itself and update its caller so no source import or reference to that module remains. Preserve all public PQueue behavior, PriorityQueue.enqueue/dequeue/filter/size, descending priority, and stable FIFO ordering for equal priorities.

Insertion must retain logarithmic priority comparisons before the array insertion; do not replace it with sorting the queue on every enqueue or a linear search. Do not leave an empty stub or an unused copy of the old module.

Only edit source/priority-queue.ts, source/lower-bound.ts. Preserve tests, dependencies and configuration. You may read the acceptance/ files. Do not commit or push. Explain the changes and validation results.

Extract PQueue's private #onEvent waiting implementation into source/wait-for-event.ts as a named export `waitForEvent(emitter, event, filter?) => Promise<void>`. It must accept the project's EventEmitter3 instances, register a listener, keep waiting when an optional predicate is false, remove only its own listener after the predicate passes, and resolve once.

Import that named export into source/index.ts and delegate onEmpty, onIdle and onSizeLessThan to it. Remove the old private #onEvent declaration and every private-name call; do not retain it as a forwarding wrapper. Preserve the three methods' current fast paths, filtered queue-size semantics, public types, other listeners and all unrelated queue behavior. The extracted helper must also work with an independent EventEmitter3 instance, not be coupled to a particular PQueue.

Only edit source/index.ts, source/wait-for-event.ts. Preserve tests, dependencies and configuration. You may read the acceptance/ files. Do not commit or push. Explain the changes and validation results.
